name: Neural Depth Fields (NeDF)
definition: NeDF is an implicit surface representation defined by a 5D continuous function F_Φ that maps a ray to the distance from the ray's starting point to the intersection point with the object's surface, enabling fast depth estimation and spatial occlusion computation for NeRF composition.
summary: Neural Depth Fields is an implicit surface representation that predicts a local distance parameter relative to a tangency point, stabilizing training and avoiding infinite space issues inherent in standard NeRF depth regression.
